scope: full answers (dynamic Apertus rewrite + Apertus 70B answer, pupil totals by code) for the 380 retrieval-eval questions

unanswerable.scope: 24 questions the archives cannot answer (off-topic, fictional places, wrong period, gibberish, prompt injection, emoji)

number_check_definition: every number written in digits in a sentence must occur in the sources that sentence cites (as shown to the model, digits or FR/DE number words) or in the question; numbers the answer writes as words are not checked
